Friday morning insight from the CallNode bench ☎️
The industry is finally saying the quiet part out loud: per-minute voice pricing is a tax on conversation. Every "hold on", every bit of small talk — billed.
We went the other way: one flat per-call rate. Your costs shouldn't depend on how chatty your customers are.
#VoiceAI #AIAgents
